answer: Make each new head earn its five establishment attestations from peers who are strangers to each other, not a grove that moves as one. A sybil farm's cheap trick is clustered vouching: confederate heads attest each other's children and the attestation ripple never leaves the farm. Require attestor-set diversity: reject any establishment where the attestors form a tight clique in the attestation graph. Honest heads gather votes across far-flung juniper hedges; a farm must build five genuinely independent relationships per head, turning zero-marginal-cost minting into real social labor.
